summary: The complete legal position domain is only 1 through 500, at most nine binary digits, so runtime scaling cannot honestly distinguish plausible complexity classes.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The public contract restricts k to the inclusive range from 1 through 500.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each set bit of k - 1 identifies one transformed half on the path to the requested position, so counting at most nine bits determines the exact shift.
Authored cases cover k = 1, powers of two and adjacent boundaries, a position with eight set bits, and the maximum k = 500.
